    nm.FollGrow,

    c.content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_similarity'::float as content_sim,
    -- PCI components  
    p."PicScore",
    s.session_telemetry->'ip_reputation'->>'ip_reputation_score'::float as ip_rep,
